title: Interactive Gambling Amendment (Ending Online Wagering on Greyhound Racing) Bill 2025
short_title: Interactive Gambling Amendment (Ending Online Wagering on Greyhound Racing) Bill 2025

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would prohibit online betting on greyhound racing by changing how racing wagering services are treated under the Commonwealth's interactive gambling legislation.
It would remove greyhound races from the racing wagering exclusion and adjust the wording governing the remaining listed racing services in the same provision.
The sponsor proposed a two-year delay after Royal Assent to allow the industry time to address the welfare of dogs affected by reduced revenue.
changes: Greyhound racing would cease to qualify for the racing wagering exclusion in subsection 8A(1).
The exclusion's wording would clarify that it covers either or both of the remaining listed racing services.
The amendments would take effect two years following Royal Assent.
summary.affected: Online wagering businesses, people betting online on greyhound races and the greyhound racing industry are affected.
